verdict.rationale: Sprinto documents live dashboards showing compliance posture (sprinto-docs-22) and multi-framework management (sprinto-docs-23). It also emphasizes continuous readiness monitoring (sprinto-docs-25), and a 'Framework Health' API page exists (sprinto-docs-17), which together suggest per-framework health tracking. However, the evidence never describes a readiness view with passing-control counts, open gaps, remaining work, or a single readiness percentage. Missing for 10: an explicit per-framework readiness percentage, a breakdown of passing vs. failing controls and open gaps, documentation of the readiness dashboard itself, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
